authorization: User accepted five-model selection and authorized autonomous research continuation; long tasks background, four parallel independent tasks. User explicitly requires E98 postprocessor.
objective: Learn and validate differentiable draft Loss aligned with final quality after one frozen fixed-depth postprocessor; offline within-problem ranking, local direction checks, then limited matched-start training only after objective registration.

database.population: Frozen panel.json uniformly sampled1000 from original train16000
database.draft_rule: Exactly one unperturbed neural draft from each of five distinct completed model weights for every case; do not use five checkpoints from one run or perturbations to fill quota
database.perturbations: Optional later explicitly registered auxiliary checks; not used to replace any of the five core model drafts
database.convergence_scope: Operational validation-based stopping; does not claim global convergence or flat training Loss

scope.current_stage: authorized database, offline mathematical analysis and local direction research

public_task: Public MIB mean-area transform from protocol, same IDs and scale for all sources; reference used only for Loss/supervision, never network inputs
archived_port_representation: For historical E68/E70/E71 frozen inference only, retain their original public full-port readers and14-dimensional input; compressing their inputs would change the selected function. New trainable architecture is not introduced here.
evaluation: Later stage will freeze an independent local fixed-depth evaluator copied with provenance; regenerate all5000 Q labels with that one evaluator rather than mixing historical clock/depth Q
analysis: Store actual independent Loss terms; fit nonnegative scale-constrained regularized within-case ranking weights. Split by case and examine leave-one-model-source-out behavior; mixed-Q objective includes equal and official size weighting.
decision: Check unseen-case ranking/regret and local Loss-descent/Q direction before actual training; fixed own-Loss controls within-phase monitoring/best/LR/earlystop; Q is the outer alignment criterion, not hidden checkpoint selection.
protection: All E98 STOPs and historical evidence remain; no E98 restarts; original model paths remain unchanged; E101/E102 untouched.
next_stage: Launch database1000x5 -> offline fits -> local descent checks -> report; inspect evidence to register subsequent finite neural training comparison. Do not start unsupported long training.
numerical_path: New registered CPU FP32 deterministic inference for all five frozen models; four single-thread workers with original source public-input and decoder semantics. No historical draft/Q reuse.
inference_reproduction: CPU and dynamic exact-n padding may differ numerically from original GPU training/evaluation; original weights and mathematical graph preserved, not claiming historical bitwise draft reproduction.

parallelism.unit: one case with five frozen source models; independent cases run concurrently
parallelism.offline_fits: four regularization fits concurrently; five source holdouts at most4 concurrently

analysis_registration.objective: case-weighted within-case logistic ranking with nonnegative simplex scaled weights; fit-only75th percentile absolute pair-difference scales; original coefficient prior; same total physical coefficient sum
analysis_registration.selection: tune200 mixed regret only, tie by ranking accuracy then stronger regularization; freeze proposal before finalcheck200 and source-holdout reports
analysis_registration.source_holdout: 5 leave-one-source-out fits using the already selected regularization; source-involving pairs on check200 descriptive only
analysis_registration.case_weights: half equal-case plus half official exp(n/12), normalized on each analysis panel
analysis_registration.network_training_case_aggregation: not yet registered; must be fixed before any new neural training

direction_registration.source_split: first40 internally randomized tune cases, chosen before Q
direction_registration.step_rule: RMS-normalized gradient in per-module sqrt(area) center units and log-aspect; mask fixed channels, clamp normalized gradient components to[-3,3]; original area/spec decoder
direction_registration.gate: both step sizes improve mixedQ >.0001 and outperform original-Loss local steps; layout-space evidence only, not neural training proof

postprocessor_registration.version: E98 fixed-depth v1 unmodified, main shape-call caps4/4/7/8, all original hard guards
postprocessor_registration.runtime: concurrent CPU timings are throughput diagnostics, not deployment latency or contest score

stop: Create current RUN/STOP or experiment STOP. Workers finish the active fixed-depth solve and stop before following draft/case; no later analysis/stages.
terminal: Offline stage reports numerical evidence and finite next-step recommendation. No dev postprocessingQ or test payloads; no automatic retry on numerical/error cases.
